composition_subtypes.role: primary mechanism: greedy selection after sorting to maximize goods

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort prices, then greedily take pairs and individual items in two patterns to maximize count within budget.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the array and uses a greedy strategy to select items in two patterns (even-pair and odd-start) to maximize the number of goods. No DP is used; it's purely greedy with sorting as preprocessing.
